name: cTSEffectsExtension::Construct
notes: Hooked (adapter Construct): our constructor installs our vtables, and every overridden slot of the class is now ours (the stubs are replaced); the remaining slots are compiler thunks into cExtension's verified bodies. EffectsExtension_ConstructDestruct runs the image constructor and ours 24 times on poisoned memory and compares the registry shape, the bound/state bytes, the text, the four vtable words (set, ours not the image's) and the destructor's free sets. The ctor-state44 and ctor-mask mutants are killed.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::Destruct
notes: EffectsExtension_ConstructDestruct exercises both teardown paths; internal sentinel and bucket allocations are freed by the registry destructor call.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::DeletingDestructor
notes: EffectsExtension_DeletingDestructorFlags compares the return value and recorded frees for flags 0, 0x100 and 1; mutant changing bit 0 to bit 1 was killed.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::FindEffectNode
notes: EffectsExtension_FindEffectNode compares null, empty, case-insensitive locator and forwarded-name cases; the fake verifies the original helper receives name, node and 0xf. Mutants for the locator shortcut and null/empty shortcut were killed.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::FindRecord
notes: EffectsExtension_FindRecord compares result bytes for zero, one and two records, hits and misses across both strings and the discriminator. Mutants reversing the first comparison and discriminator check were killed.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::RemoveRecord
notes: EffectsExtension_RemoveRecord compares list and bucket links, record and string frees, 0x58-byte record allocation, refcount effects and output across singleton and two-record tail removals; EffectsExtension_RemoveRecordBuckets adds the head and tail of a multi-record bucket range, and the coordinator's rm-tail, rm-head and rm-single mutants are killed (RemoveRecord, ActiveFilters, RemoveActive).

name: cTSEffectsExtension::RemoveByInstance
notes: EffectsExtension_RemoveByInstance covers empty, nonmatching-instance and matching-instance paths, the slot-4 value, release, record free, registry count and the byte-sized bool result.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::HasActiveEffect
notes: EffectsExtension_HasActiveEffect covers empty lists, null objects, false and true instance slot 5 answers. The inverted-active mutant is included in the small-slot mutation run.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::SetStateByte1
notes: EffectsExtension_BroadcastSettings covers unchanged and changed low-byte states, full 0x100 forwarding, null records and instance slot 8.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::SetStateByte2
notes: EffectsExtension_BroadcastSettings covers unchanged and changed low-byte states, full 0x100 forwarding, null records and instance slot 7.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::BroadcastThree
notes: EffectsExtension_BroadcastSettings checks all three distinct argument values at two nonnull instances and skips a null record instance.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::BroadcastTwo
notes: EffectsExtension_BroadcastSettings checks both distinct argument values at two nonnull instances and skips a null record instance.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::RemoveActive
notes: EffectsExtension_RemoveActive covers kind mismatch, kind 0 (matches every record, via EffectsExtension_ActiveFilters), inactive and flagged records, and an active matching record; compares slot 4, release, refcount, 0x58-byte free, links and count. The active-kind0, active-kind and active-flag mutants are killed.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::FilterActive
notes: EffectsExtension_FilterActive checks kind mismatch, byte flags 0 and 0x100, the matching false-flag broadcast and nonzero delegation to slot 8 (flags 1, 2 and 0x201); EffectsExtension_ActiveFilters covers kind 0, negative kinds and the flag condition. The filter-kind, filter-kind-neg, filter-flag, filter-flag-drop and filter-delegate mutants are killed.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf24_14
notes: EffectsExtension_Unbind tests zero/nonzero gate states, the slot-9 pass that removes a null-instance kind-zero record while retaining kind 1, and the subsequent per-instance slot-4 (1) / slot-14 (2,0) notifications. Original side uses the original face vtable. Three mutants killed for gate, slot-9 call and notification argument.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf24_3
notes: EffectsExtension_CollectNamed covers zero, one and two linked records with exact, prefix-mismatch and later-record name matches; compares the complete vector and byte return. Name-provider slot 5 is faked; allocator-service growth is backed by shared process-heap allocate/free callbacks. Three mutants killed: reversed equality, wrong output field, and constant false result.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf24_0
notes: EffectsExtension_GetDisplayName covers nonnull owner with a display name and null display-name fallback for null and nonnull owners; compares full byte return, stored cRZString contents and argument/call count to 0xae7900. Three mutants killed: wrong assignment branch, wrong fallback owner value and return value.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf24_15
notes: EffectsExtension_BindEffects compares the one-shot byte gate, gets the owner, resolves the second record string through helper 0xcc5b50/0xae7490, skips null instances and null node results, and checks slot 14 (2,node) plus slot 3 (1). It covers null/non-null lookup answers and a pre-bound call; four mutants killed for wrong string field, node argument, gate, and slot-3 value.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf24_6
notes: EffectsExtension_FindInstance covers empty and one-record registries, matches first/second strings including null-to-empty second text, verifies the key discriminator and the returned instance pointer. Original hash helpers 0x4fea40 and 0x141a14 are used; three mutants killed for second-key handling, bucket hash and return value.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf24_5
notes: EffectsExtension_RemoveByKey checks empty registry, inactive and active matched instances, and a same-bucket discriminator miss. It compares full eax return, setting slot 4 only when active, release count, links, bucket/count state and record/string frees. Three mutants killed for inverted active result, wrong setter value and omitted removal.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf24_9
notes: EffectsExtension_ProcessUnused covers kind 1 skip, null-instance deletion, inactive/active records, slot-6 gating with low-byte 0x100/0x101, reference counts 2/3/4, the second release, and record/string frees. Four mutants killed for kind branch, active branch, threshold and clearing instance before removal.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf24_19
notes: EffectsExtension_WriteRecords checks empty and two-record streams, including vf9(1) prepass, version/count, cRZString object pointers and values, hash, kind and byte flag. The original side uses its class face vtable. Three mutants killed for version, kind exclusion and string order.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf24_1
notes: Dispatch (face slot 1). EffectsExtension_DispatchBasic covers the early cases and DispatchStandalone, over a fake framework, event manager and effect factory (the service chain 0x10c9378 -> GetService(0x8af76dc8, 0x4af76d8c) -> Request), covers case 4 (request, node, instance slot 14 (2, node), slots 7/8 from the state bytes, slot 3 (0), release, return 1), the refused request (null instance) and the duplicate-case counters; both sides compared on results, side effects (calls and records) and the registry. The insert is the toolchain's map, library code.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf24_2
notes: CreateEffect (face slot 2). EffectsExtension_CreateEffect compares the factory name (the debug byte 0x43 makes it "debugEffect"), the request/node/instance calls, the record the insert makes, the bound byte (set only when the list is empty and unbound) and the returned instance, over a fake framework, manager and factory. The insert is the toolchain's map, library code.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf24_18
notes: ReadRecords (face slot 18). EffectsExtension_ReadRecords feeds byte streams with version 1 and 2 (the flag byte only from version 2), counts 0 to 1000, short and malformed streams, and compares the records the insert makes (key strings, discriminator, kind, flag, instance) and the stream position on both sides; RecordsRoundTrip writes with slot 19 and reads back. The version-1 flag is uninitialised in the original (ours 0), so the test keeps it out of the compared bytes. The insert is the toolchain's map, library code.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf24_22
notes: BuildStatusText (face slot 22). The text is built and dropped, so the test observes it through its inputs: the cRZString::Sprintf call (0x1ad6f7) arguments and the IsActive calls the original makes; EffectsExtension_StatusText compares them over empty, one-record and active/inactive lists.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::QueryInterface
notes: The referent face's QueryInterface (cIGZUnknown slot 0). EffectsExtension_QueryInterface asks twelve iids (the effects face 0x0bb263d5, cExtension's, the unknown, behaviour ones, unknown ones) and compares the answer, the offset of the face returned and the counted words, with accepted and refused answers required.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf108_0
notes: A vtordisp thunk of the cIExtension vtable 0xeb8dd4 (QueryInterface). Unhooked: it exists only in our vtable once the constructor is ours. EffectsExtension_InterfaceSlots calls it through the interface on the image's object and ours and compares the answers, faces returned and counts.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf108_1
notes: A vtordisp thunk of the cIExtension vtable 0xeb8dd4 (AddRef). Unhooked: it exists only in our vtable once the constructor is ours. EffectsExtension_InterfaceSlots calls AddRef through the interface on the image's object and ours and compares the answers and the count word.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf108_2
notes: A vtordisp thunk of the cIExtension vtable 0xeb8dd4 (Release). Unhooked: it exists only in our vtable once the constructor is ours. EffectsExtension_InterfaceSlots calls Release through the interface on the image's object and ours and compares the answers and the count word.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf108_11
notes: A vtordisp thunk of the cIExtension vtable 0xeb8dd4 (IsActive). Unhooked: it exists only in our vtable once the constructor is ours. EffectsExtension_InterfaceSlots calls it through the interface on the image's object and ours.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf108_16
notes: A vtordisp thunk of the cIExtension vtable 0xeb8dd4 (GetPersistReferent). Unhooked: it exists only in our vtable once the constructor is ours. EffectsExtension_InterfaceSlots compares the offset of the referent face it returns.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf108_19
notes: A vtordisp thunk of the cIExtension vtable 0xeb8dd4 (GetNextConst). Unhooked: it exists only in our vtable once the constructor is ours. EffectsExtension_InterfaceSlots calls it through the interface on both sides.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf108_21
notes: A vtordisp thunk of the cIExtension vtable 0xeb8dd4 (slot 21). Unhooked: it exists only in our vtable once the constructor is ours. EffectsExtension_InterfaceSlots calls the slot family around it (owner, next) on both sides; slot 21 itself (SetOwner) is not called because the original binds the effects to the owner node.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf108_22
notes: A vtordisp thunk of the cIExtension vtable 0xeb8dd4 (SetNext). Unhooked: it exists only in our vtable once the constructor is ours. EffectsExtension_InterfaceSlots calls SetNext(nullptr) on both sides and compares the following owner/next reads.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf108_23
notes: A vtordisp thunk of the cIExtension vtable 0xeb8dd4 (IsKindOf). Unhooked: it exists only in our vtable once the constructor is ours. InheritedVirtuals and InterfaceSlots ask nine and five iids on both sides.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf108_25
notes: A vtordisp thunk of the cIExtension vtable 0xeb8dd4 (GetTypeName). Unhooked: it exists only in our vtable once the constructor is ours. InheritedVirtuals and InterfaceSlots compare the type name text on both sides.

name: cTSEffectsExtension::vf108_26
notes: A vtordisp thunk of the cIExtension vtable 0xeb8dd4 (GetDescription). Unhooked: it exists only in our vtable once the constructor is ours. InheritedVirtuals and InterfaceSlots compare the description text on both sides.

notes: A vtordisp thunk of the cIExtension vtable 0xeb8dd4 (OnEvent): the compiler's thunk into cExtension's body. Unhooked, not tested: the event slots walk the game's event registry, which the harness does not initialise (calling them corrupts the image's heap), so no test can call them.
